_README.licence_note: Harvested fields are OpenStreetMap data under ODbL 1.0. Attribution is required. Do not remove this block.

fields.name_bn: Bangla form, from OSM name / name:bn.
fields.aliases: Variant spellings and local synonyms. Hand-entered; OSM has almost none.
fields.kind: junction | bridge | terminal | mall | market | campus | hospital | police | park | neighbourhood | area | town | road | stop.
fields.radius_m: Default by kind, and a judgment call rather than a measurement — except on a road, where it is half the measured extent of the road's own segments, clamped to [250, 1500].
fields.source: osm:<type>/<id>, or 'manual' for a hand-added entry.
fields.reviewed: True only once a person has checked this row. The harvest sets false.
fields.ambiguous: True when this entry's name cannot identify one place: either the name is shared with another entry far enough away that choosing would put the pin kilometres wrong, or the entry is a road longer than 3 km, which a point and a radius cannot describe honestly. The loader refuses to resolve a query that matches only ambiguous entries, rather than picking one.
fields.segments: Roads only. How many OSM ways were merged into this entry.
fields.span_m: Roads only. The measured end-to-end extent of those ways.

_README.roads_are_lines_and_this_file_stores_poi: A road arrives from OSM as many short ways. Their centres are chained into one entry per road per locality, the point is the centroid and the radius is half the measured extent. A road over 3 km long is marked ambiguous instead, because a pin at the midpoint of Mirpur Road would be up to 4 km from the incident and a wrong pin is worse than no pin.
_README.hand_work_still_outstanding: aliases and radius_m. OSM spells the Mirpur 10 roundabout 'গোলচক্কর'; much of Dhaka says 'গোলচত্বর'. The gazetteer is only better than a general map once those synonyms are in.
